items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:45:1
items.html:
And those two lower joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik are found in the world of Beria: These matters are astonishing at first glance, for what brought about the division of the NHY of Atik into three thirds in such a manner, until the world of Atzilut does not suffice for them and the last two thirds are compelled to go out into the world of Beria? And also, why did not all three thirds clothe in the HGT NHY of AA? And what is the relation of the upper thirds with the HGT of AA, and of the middle thirds with the NHY of AA?
Indeed these matters are deeper than the sea, and we shall explain them here as far as this place allows. And know that the source of the division into thirds in this manner is drawn from the NHY of AK. For it has been explained above (in the Inner Observation, Part 6, page 446, item 14; and see also page 451, item 26) that because of the second restriction of AK, in which the two Heys, the first and the second, joined together, the point of restriction, which had been in the place of this world, in the discernment of the Malchut of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK, rose to the place of the Sefira Bina of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK; so that the three Sefirot, Bina and ZON of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK, remained below the Sium of the line of Ein Sof, that is, below the point of restriction, and it is they that became the place of the three worlds Beria, Yetzira and Assiya. Study it there well, in the two places mentioned above.
And even afterwards, when the light that breached the Parsa descended and clothed in the NHY of AK, the new boundary was not changed on that account. But the ZAT of Nekudim, which came out from the illumination of the NHY of AK together with AVI of Nekudim, passed beyond the new boundary and wished to expand in their reign also below the new boundary, that is, into the three worlds BYA; and therefore they were broken and died and remained in BYA, that is, in the place of their reign, as written in Part 7.
Now, the NHY of AK, whose Bina and ZON went out and became BYA while their Keter and Hochma remained in Atzilut — these Bina and ZON are reckoned as only the two lower thirds of the ten Sefirot of these NHY. For so are the AHP of all the degrees that go outside the degree regarded. For you will find that the ARI calls the AHP of Keter that went outside of Keter, above, by the name of the five lower Sefirot of the Keter of BON, which are TNHYM alone. And also the main of the Sefira Tifferet, that is, its upper third, is regarded as the upper half of Keter, and only the two lower thirds of Tifferet belong to the AHP; so that to the upper half of Keter, which is only Galgalta ve Einayim, there belong six Sefirot of the degree, which are KHB HGT, and to the lower half of Keter, which is AHP, there belong only four Sefirot of the degree, NHYM. And the reason for this has already been explained in Part 7, and this is not the place to elaborate.
And therefore it is regarded that the six upper Sefirot of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK remained in Atzilut, and only the four Sefirot NHYM of these ten Sefirot went out and became BYA, that is, from their Chazeh [chest] downwards. And in this measure the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK are found divided into three thirds, which are KHB, HGT and NHYM, of which the two upper thirds, KHB HGT, remained in Atzilut, and only the lower thirds, which are NHYM, became BYA. And it is known that there is no absence in spirituality, and the matter of the second restriction
that was made in the NHY of AK is only discernments of additions upon them, so that no change whatsoever was made in the first NHY of AK, which even now end at the point of this world, in the secret of the verse, “And His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives.”
And it is known that the Partzuf Atik of Atzilut is intermediate between AK and the Partzufim of Atzilut, and in it there serves the self of the Malchut of AK, which is the discernment of the bottom Hey from before the restriction, which is the secret of the Malchut that is concealed in the Radla [the unknown head]; and her self is not revealed in the least in any of the Partzufim of Atzilut, and this is because she is the quality of judgment without the partnership of the quality of mercy, which is the first Hey. And therefore it too ends at the point of this world, like the first NHY of AK from before the second restriction, which is the secret of the partnership of the quality of mercy with judgment.
It follows that the NHY of Atik divide into three thirds, in the manner we explained above with the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK: the two upper thirds of the NHY, which are KHB and HGT, stand in Atzilut and end evenly with all the Partzufim of Atzilut, that is, at the new boundary of the second restriction; while the lower thirds, which are NHYM, are already found below the Sium of Atzilut and expand in BYA down to the point of this world, like the first NHY of AK.
And behold, those two upper thirds of the NHY, which are the discernments of KHB HGT that remained in Atzilut, are so only with respect to the vessels; but with respect to the light in them they are only HGT NHY, as is known, that HGT NHY of lights clothe in KHB HGT of vessels. And this is his saying, “that the two upper joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik clothed in Hesed and Gevura of AA, and the Yesod in the Tifferet of AA,” and this is as explained, that the upper thirds of the NHY of Atik are KHB of vessels and HGT of lights, and therefore their place too is in the HGT of AA. “And the two middle joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik in the Netzah-Hod of AA, and the Atara of the Yesod of Atik in the Yesod of AA, and the Malchut of Atik in the Malchut of AA,” that is, as explained, that the middle joints of the NHY of Atik are likewise HGT of vessels and NHY of lights, and therefore they clothe in the NHYM of AA. And as for what he says, that the Malchut of Atik clothes in the Malchut of AA, it is not the Malchut of Atik itself, but only the discernment of an illumination from its Malchut, for the Malchut of Atik is concealed in the Radla and is not revealed, as above in the words of the ARI (page 618, item 23). Study it there well.
And this is his saying, “And those two lower joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik are found in the world of Beria, revealed without any garment,” that is, as explained, that the lower thirds of the NHY of Atik expand in BYA evenly with the legs of AK. But they are regarded as lacking Yesod and Malchut, and this is for the reason that there is no correction of the lines except in the secret of the partnership of the quality of mercy with judgment, which is drawn from the second restriction; and since this expansion is of the discernment of the first restriction, there is therefore no correction of a middle line there, and therefore it is regarded as being in two lines only, right and left, without sweetening. And therefore there is nothing there but the discernment of the two lower thirds of Netzah and Hod alone, and Yesod and Malchut are lacking, except that Malchut is included in Hod, as the ARI writes in Mavo Shearim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:45:2
items.html:
The breasts of the animal, which are below at the legs, and from them the Kings who descended into Beria nursed: It has already been explained above (page 637, the passage beginning “And it is fitting”) how the birth of the Partzuf causes it to fall into BYA of separation. See there. This is because the screen upon which the coupling of the upper one for the level of the Partzuf is made comes from the discernment of the Guf of Nekudim, which illuminated in BYA; and therefore there remained in the records of which the screen is comprised this power to illuminate in BYA as well.
But at the time the screen was refined of all the Guf coarseness that was in it, this admixture of the illumination of BYA too was not apparent in it, that is, all the while it was included in the coupling of the Rosh. But after the Guf coarseness in the screen became apparent, the power of the illumination of BYA that it had in Nekudim was immediately revealed in it, and then it separated from the Rosh and descended to its place in BYA. Thus its birth, which means the recognition of the Guf coarseness in the screen, which takes it out of the discernment of the upper one and brings it to its own place, caused it to fall into BYA. And this applies in all the Partzufim of Atzilut, since they all came out of the screen of the Guf of Nekudim, which illuminated in BYA, except for the Partzuf Atik, which in truth had the correction enabling it to expand into BYA, since it is the one that clothes the self of the Malchut of AK from before the second restriction, as above.
And the essential correction that suffices to raise them once more to Atzilut is the separation of the power of the illumination of BYA from them, and the attainment of the strong power of Sium of the second restriction, which is the discernment of the Malchut of AA, in which lies the power of Sium of all Atzilut. And this is the secret of the breasts of the animal, which are the discernment of the two lower thirds of Netzah-Hod of Atik that are found in BYA, as above in the adjacent item; study it there well. And they joined and were corrected in one partnership with the Malchut of AA, and by the combination of the two the breasts of the animal were made fit to bestow upon the Partzuf the strong power of Sium of the second restriction that is in the Malchut of AA. And this is his saying, “And those two lower joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik are found in Beria, revealed without any garment, and these joined together and clothed in the Malchut of AA.” For then they can nurse the abundance of Atzilut even though they stand in BYA, since they receive the illumination of the Malchut of AA through the two lower thirds of NH of Atik that are found together with them in one world, until they receive the discernment of the Sium of Atzilut, and then they rise to their place in Atzilut.
And they are called the breasts of the animal because Malchut is called so at the time she is without sweetening from the quality of mercy. And their opposite are the breasts of man, which indicate that Malchut is sweetened with the quality of mercy; and this is the secret of their standing at the level of Bina, which is the root of mercy, for this is why they are attached at the place of the heart, which is Bina, as is known. And they are not below at the legs, where there is a grip for the shells, in the secret of “Her feet go down to death.” And therefore it is a place of nakedness, meaning that there is a grip there for the external ones. And this is the secret of the fact that Behemah [animal] in Gematria is BON. And understand this.
